items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Lucy and I were on our way to the Lafayette Theatre, Edgar Hayes's wife.

ctx.x: You came up, obviously, to New York. Was he still in contact with you in West Virginia?

No, no, I ran into him here in New York. Lucy and I were on our way to the Lafayette Theatre, Edgar Hayes's wife. We were turning into 135th Street, Small's Paradise there. He was standing out there -
